Capability: Box-selects entities by dragging a window or crossing rectangle, filtered to all, pipes, nodes, supports or components, and discards stale gestures.

Capability: Builds, validates and queues a new bend, tee, reducer, valve, flange or expansion joint at a node with its per-kind geometry, stiffness and source references.

Capability: Declares the toolkit command vocabulary with status and route, and decides availability from selection type and count, undo/redo history and busy state.

Capability: Lets the user choose Entered, SI or US display units for all readouts, while editing stays in entered units.

Capability: Persists per-user UI preferences (theme, density, split and drawer sizes) in browser storage with bounds, versioning and fallback, and supports keyboard resizing of splitters and drawers.
Checks returned and reopened project data: recomputes model and envelope hashes against stored claims, accepts only the supported persisted normalization, and guards stale persistence observations.

Capability: Maps registered software status and evidence tokens to display labels with their authority domain, and renders unregistered status values readably without inventing labels.

Capability: Rule-pack manager lists, creates, opens, saves and deletes project-scoped rule packs in the private local store, refusing edits without a project or while busy.

Capability: User validates a draft rule pack to see validation findings, and computes and stamps a canonical checksum into the draft document.

Capability: Structured expression composer builds the typed formula tree (arithmetic, compare, logical, min/max, interpolate and lookup tables) through form controls with a read-only text preview.

Capability: Rule-pack document helpers parse draft text, collect declared variables and formulas, and rewrite a formula expression while preserving untouched members.
Notes: Client-side document manipulation only; canonical validation happens in the backend service.

Capability: User adds, removes and edits a rule pack's required inputs and value slots, including dimension, catalog unit, library value and solver result references.
Notes: Unknown values use an explicit TBD placeholder rather than silent defaults; placeholder provenance is private by default. Also exports shared form widgets reused by the check editor.

Capability: User authors acceptability checks that bind declared inputs, value slots and a formula, choosing basis, allowed result statuses and diagnostic codes from closed vocabularies.
Notes: Out-of-vocabulary stored values and unresolved references are shown as marked options rather than snapped to defaults.

Capability: Rule-check completeness panel reports why rule checking is blocked (missing user rule inputs, absent component provenance, unit policy) separately from mechanics status, with JSON export.
Notes: Findings are derived heuristically from status strings and model content; no dedicated unit test file for this panel.

Capability: User runs a rule pack's checks against the solved model, choosing the bundled demo, a saved local pack or pasted JSON, and sees per-check and worst-of aggregate user statuses.
Notes: Execution is desktop-only; browser preview reports an unavailable route. The saved-pack list control has no test that targets it directly.

Capability: Before a rule-check run the user supplies value slot entries, selects solver result rows and sees read-only previews resolving solver-result and library references and unit binding policy.

Capability: Report packet panel summarizes model, units, statuses, component and hanger evidence, diagnostics, run hashes, comparison, persistence, editor intents and proposals, with redacted JSON export.
Notes: Raw report view is suppressed when redaction controls redact any value; only the sanitized JSON is offered.

Capability: User renders the calculation report through the native renderer, sees its canonical SHA-256, gate state and blocking reasons, previews it, and saves HTML or prints when not blocked.
Notes: Requires a solved result and analysis run. Printed output is a derived view naming the hash, not hash-bound evidence.

Capability: Builds the report renderer input document from session state: references, disclosures, section list, unit display summary and canonical hashes, keeping unknowns as visible TBD markers.
Notes: Document composition, gating and hashing of the final report are done by the native renderer, not here.

Capability: Builds a report package save request after verifying the input manifest, matching model hashes and finite results, and refusing when active rule-check metadata would need binding.

Capability: User records explicit local-private intent and saves a report package, seeing the redaction summary and save status.
Notes: Panel exposes controls only; the save handler and menu command live in the workspace shell.

Capability: Projects current-session model state, analysis run and comparison into report-section records, kept equal to a shared fixture produced by the backend section assembler.

Capability: Applies export redaction controls to the three report routes: on-screen report and JSON, renderer input, and local-private package request.

Capability: Report content lint scans report surfaces for synthetic protected, private or proprietary markers and prohibited professional-authority phrases, producing blocking findings and lint JSON.

Capability: Classifies export payload items by explicit privacy and redistribution metadata per export context, deciding include, warn, redact value or field, omit, or block export.

Capability: Enforces local-first export routing: only allow-listed routes and valid contexts pass, local-private export needs explicit intent, and lossy redaction withholds lossless payloads.

Capability: User picks an export context, records local-private intent, reviews redaction findings, and downloads a checksummed redacted model manifest only when nothing blocks.

Capability: Wraps every panel download link, mapping it to an export route and context, gating on intent, payload exactness and decoded-payload validation, and using native save in desktop.

Capability: Load case manager lists load cases, primitive loads and combinations in virtualized, selectable lists with a boundary note.
Notes: No dedicated unit test file; covered through app-level tests.

Capability: User creates, edits metadata of and deletes load cases by queuing editor intents with a preview, rationale and provenance.

Capability: User creates primitive loads on pipes or supports, edits magnitude and unit checked against the unit catalog, and deletes them via queued intents.

Capability: User creates load combinations, adds or removes terms, changes basis and factors, and deletes combinations via queued intents with previews.

Capability: User imports a material, section, component or hanger library document, validates provenance with blocking and advisory findings, and saves, lists, opens or deletes private local libraries.

Capability: User drafts library entries field by field (material properties with temperature reference, section quantities, component fields) using catalog units, then applies them to the document.

Capability: Project validation preflight reports schema and version, round-trip categories, unit round-trip, model and envelope hash evidence, migration evidence and persistence operations, with JSON export.

Capability: Project storage audit reports storage capability, local-only boundary, snapshot and index, hash persistence and integrity, unit round-trip and payload boundary, with JSON export.
Notes: No dedicated unit test file.

Capability: Validation evidence review displays a static map of validation manual sections, evidence areas and states, release-readiness profiles and required paths, and release gates, with JSON export.

Capability: Validates a boundary draft (unique node, global frame, explicit mode per DOF, positive spring stiffness with unit, ID collisions) and maps it to rigid-first anchor/spring support create operations.

Capability: Hosts the Operations section tabs (review, geometry, supports, self weight, agent, details), including stored proposed context that can be requeued for fresh validation.

Capability: Offers Project page controls to create, start blank, open, list and save local projects, open a listed project by id, and read the project message and review-context summary.
Builds validated two-node 3D Euler-Bernoulli frame elements and their 12x12 local stiffness for axial, torsion and two bending planes (shear deformation excluded).
Notes: Zero external dependencies. Rejects nonfinite, nonpositive and degenerate inputs via a typed error enum. Base kernel reused by straight-pipe, curved-bend, supports, nonlinear loop and the product physics crate.

Capability: Carries caller-supplied unit-system and unit identifiers per canonical dimension and canonical model references at the solver boundary without converting units.
Notes: Metadata only; consumed by the performance harness, straight-pipe boundary metadata and diagnostics. Not used by the product physics crate.

Capability: Defines linear support families (anchor, guide, line stop, vertical support, spring, imposed displacement) with dimension-tagged quantities and optional unit metadata.
Notes: No support or catalog defaults supplied.

Capability: Prepares restrained DOFs, spring entries and imposed-displacement entries from linear supports, emitting findings for missing data, duplicates and invalid DOFs.
Notes: Called by product physics.

Capability: Applies prepared supports to a dense global system by adding spring stiffness to diagonals and reducing rigid restraints and imposed displacements.
Notes: Linear behaviour only; gap, one-way and friction behaviour are handled by the nonlinear support crates.

Capability: Builds a straight two-node pipe element from explicit area, second moments and torsion constant and exposes its frame stiffness.
Notes: No pipe dimension tables or material defaults. Used by product physics.

Capability: Computes consistent equivalent nodal loads for the outward radial pressure-imbalance wall load on a curved bend from a pressure-thrust magnitude.
Notes: Caller supplies thrust and applies the end-cap force pair; used by product physics.

Capability: Recovers section force resultants at any arc fraction of a curved bend, with or without distributed and radial pressure loads, and reports end tangents.
Notes: Used by product physics.

Capability: Classifies each nonlinear support as active, inactive, sticking or sliding from trial displacements and reactions and reports state changes, residual and convergence.
Notes: State-switched complementarity: engaged supports test reaction sign, released supports test penetration. Does not assemble or solve.

Capability: Applies a bounded tangential friction force at sliding supports using an explicit or support-reaction-derived normal force and the user friction coefficient.
Notes: No load-path or load-step friction history. A sliding seed defers convergence one iteration.

Capability: Lumps uniform force-per-length element loads to equivalent nodal forces using caller-supplied element span and connectivity.
Notes: Translational global loads only. Only the mechanics benchmark calls it outside the crate.

Capability: Generates wind equivalent-static uniform loads on user-marked spans as pressure times shape factor times exposed diameter, optionally over a partial extent.
Notes: No wind profile or exposure catalog. Called by product physics.

Capability: Dispatches algebra expressions, enforces operand and dimension compatibility, preserves analysis status, rejects human-approval status and builds result boundary records.
Notes: evaluate_expression and the boundary-record builder have no caller outside the crate; product physics dispatches the operations itself. No general expression parser.

Capability: Recovers mechanics stress components (axial, bending, torsional shear, thin-wall pressure membrane) and summaries from force resultants, section properties and optional pressure.
Notes: No code stress equations, allowables or indices. Called by product physics.

Capability: Recovers stresses at individual span stations and over station sweeps from straight-pipe station resultants.
Notes: Only the stress benchmark calls it outside the crate.

Capability: Derives pipe section properties and mass per length from diameter and wall, reducing the wall by a user mill tolerance when present.
Notes: No default tolerance is applied.

Capability: Converts authored primitive loads (nodal forces and moments, full and partial-span uniform loads, global or local directions) into element and nodal mechanics loads.
Generates seismic and wind equivalent-static distributed or nodal loads from user gravity, density, factors and marked exposed spans, blocking when inputs are missing or overlap.
Notes: No default gravity or environmental values. Sub-span wind is not allowed on curved-bend macro spans.

Capability: Reports signed global node displacement and rotation components and displacement magnitudes per load case.
Plans self-weight load operations for selected pipes from section, material and optional mass inputs and a signed gravity axis, failing without a partial plan.
Notes: Produces operation drafts bound to a source model hash; the caller applies them. Reached through a WASM wrapper and a desktop native command.

Capability: Derives a solver-oriented centerline analytical model from a physical source model, with traceability links and diagnostics instead of inferred defaults.
Notes: Source model is never mutated; unsupported records are omitted with diagnostics. Only tests call it; a handoff exporter cites the file path as a contract reference.

Capability: Builds a canonical result-export document from a solved run only when opaque evidence proves the exact solved payload, otherwise reports export unavailable.
Notes: Library surface only; excluded from serialized runner output. Typed legacy callers always get unavailable.

Capability: Gates runner output that may carry local-private data, withholding payloads unless explicit local-private intent is given and reporting redaction findings.
Notes: Intent inside the source payload is not trusted; binaries decide whether to print or write.

Capability: Creates and deletes nodes, refusing deletes of nodes still referenced by pipes, supports, components or loads.
Builds deterministic material, component and rule-pack-reference editor records with per-field unit metadata and validation state.
Notes: Python contract only; no product-runtime caller found.

Capability: Supplies shared unit, analysis-status, persistence-hash and source-of-truth boundary helpers and diagnostics used by the GUI record builders.
Notes: Keeps its own copy of the canonical dimension list rather than reading the units schema.

Capability: Models in-memory viewport session state and prepares node-creation, pipe-run connection, component-symbol insertion and selection command intents plus view primitives.
Notes: Standalone crate with no dependents found; the desktop viewport implements its own intents. Python test checks schema and fixture shape, not this crate.

Capability: Returns the unit catalog to the desktop frontend for unit pickers and display.
Notes: Command lives in the desktop backend; catalog content comes from the units crate.

Capability: Describes the unit core contract: storage convention for quantities, catalog scope, temperature and pressure semantics and what the crate does not wire.
Notes: Some statements describe an earlier phase and say units are not yet wired into application fields, which later code does.

Capability: Hashes deterministic JSON values, asset bytes and external artifacts into SHA-256 records and assembles an audit manifest of solver stamp, rule-pack references and asset entries.

Capability: Validates an audit manifest and reports coded findings for missing hashes, privacy and redistribution posture, and professional-boundary flags.
Notes: In-memory only; does not read project files.

Capability: Validates a calculation report record (status, diagnostics, template slots, provenance, rule-pack references, unresolved TBDs) and yields the fixed required-section order.
Notes: Type and validation basis consumed by the HTML renderer, PDF emitter and package crates; no direct application caller. A separate Python schema check exists for the record shape but does not execute this crate.

Capability: Validates report disclosure sections (warnings, assumptions, user-supplied values, provenance notes, limitations, unresolved TBDs, human-review findings) and sorts diagnostics.
Notes: Consumed by renderer, PDF emitter and package crates only.

Capability: Renders a validated calculation report, disclosure sections and result rows into one self-contained scriptless HTML document whose SHA-256 is recorded as rendered-report evidence.
Notes: Reached from the desktop native render command. The assembled section model is shared with the PDF emitter. Byte layout is fixed; section order never follows input order.

Capability: Blocks report export when the bundled template, the assembled pre-render section text or the final rendered text trips a blocking protected-content finding or validation diagnostic.
Notes: Gate outcome is an export-blocked flag plus reasons; uses the protected-content lint engine. Heuristic, not a clearance.

Capability: Produces a derived print-oriented view of the canonical HTML report that carries the canonical hash and is marked as non-hash-bound.
Notes: Returned alongside the canonical HTML by the desktop render command.

Capability: Emits a byte-deterministic minimal PDF (text, tables, banners; base-14 fonts; uncompressed; fixed metadata) of the calculation report from the shared section model.
Notes: No font embedding or compression; PDF text model is linted after emission. Only caller is the report package crate.

Capability: Emits the HTML and PDF report from one assembled section model and records per-member SHA-256 hashes as a paired rendered-report outcome.
Notes: Intermediate step feeding the package container.

Capability: Assembles a byte-deterministic .opsproj project-package archive (stored ZIP, fixed order and timestamps) with a manifest of canonical-JSON members and per-member hashes.
Notes: Members: rendered HTML, PDF, audit manifest, result-export envelopes, state/comparison/handoff sections. Evidence binds to manifest member hashes, not raw archive bytes. Browser dist refuses save (desktop-only).

Capability: Accepts a wire-format report-package request, maps its DTOs to domain records with the linked solver identity, and assembles the package container.
Notes: Used by the desktop save-report-package command (behind redaction and local-first evidence checks) and by the headless runner export-results path.

Capability: Validates a result export envelope (families, units, trace links, provenance, reproducibility, boundary flags), orders values and serialises it to a schema-first JSON document.
Notes: Also used by the headless runner and the mechanics and stress benchmark crates. Listed as a desktop native-shell dependency but not called directly there.

Capability: Derives and validates a result derivative document from separately qualified source evidence, with canonical-JSON digests and checksum records.
Notes: Does not authenticate input; origin qualification is left to callers (headless solve API, desktop adapter). Guards against non-finite or unsafe JSON values.

Capability: Looks up exact result-row semantics (kind, unit, family, disposition) from a pinned semantic contract, refusing ID-substring or unit-only inference.
Notes: Embeds a fixture file at compile time from fixtures/results; panics if that file is malformed.

Capability: Scans caller-supplied report, template, example and fixture text for synthetic protected-content and private-data markers and professional-claim phrases, returning routed findings.

Capability: Command-line tool that lints named text files with the protected-content engine and prints a JSON finding list for the release-candidate scan.

Capability: Builds deterministic report-section records summarising model-state, analysis-run, comparison, handoff, export-workflow and external-prover records, with diagnostics.

Capability: Builds report sections from a canonical persisted project's embedded run-history records without mutating persistence or solver state.

Capability: Wraps a computed preview mechanics result into an immutable analysis-run record with provenance, diagnostics, result hashes and boundary flags, and validates its invariants.

Capability: Constructs strict version 0.2 analysis-run records with checked canonical hashes and verifies records by version dispatch and projection.

Capability: Verifies a legacy analysis-run checksum against its exact historical preimage without re-deriving it under a newer profile.

Capability: Compares two analysis runs and their result envelopes using explicit result mappings and unit metadata, reporting result deltas, settings deltas and diagnostics.

Capability: Derives automatic result mappings only where result IDs match exactly and unambiguously, leaving others for manual mapping.

Capability: Compares two model states by stable entity identifiers and returns a deterministic added/removed/changed diff envelope.

Capability: Records provider-neutral target mapping metadata with unsupported or approximate behaviour and diagnostics for missing mapping context.

Capability: Assembles handoff and target-mapping records into a deterministic provider-neutral export envelope and runs it through the controlled export route.

Capability: Builds non-authoritative external-prover metadata (workflow references, notes, attachments, assumptions, warnings, unsupported-target flags) with diagnostics.

Capability: Screens user-controlled handoff metadata for prohibited authority or reliance wording and reports the terms found.

Capability: Classifies private-library, private-path, secret-field and credential-placeholder references by metadata and gates their release with a metadata-only manifest.
